entities.summary: Albania is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Tirana. Official languages include Albanian. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional republic. Population: approximately 2.7 million. Area: 28,748 km². Comprehensive index for Albania covering Illyrian origins, Roman province (Via Egnatia), Byzantine/Ottoman rule (~500 years, 1385-1912), Skanderbeg resistance hero (1443-68, national symbol), Albanian National Awakening (Rilindja, League of Prizren 1878), independence 1912, Zog monarchy, Italian/German occupation WWII, Enver Hoxha communist dictatorship (1944-85, most isolated state in world, 750,000 bunkers), post-communist transition, 1997 pyramid scheme collapse (civil war), and EU candidate status.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Albania's independence in 1912 led to the establishment of a constitutional monarchy and paved the way for its post-communist transition in the late 20th century. The country's unique history, including its Ottoman and communist rule, has had a lasting impact on regional politics and identity.
